## NEXUS covenant checklist

- [ ] Work was performed on a disposable copy; no sealed archive was edited.
- [ ] Both required runners pass: `python run_tests.py` and `python -m pytest -q`.
- [ ] No frozen test was weakened, skipped, or removed.
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests and observed results are recorded.
- [ ] Release, security, and compatibility impacts are described.
- [ ] No secrets, database files, or sealed ZIP archives are included.

## Change summary

Describe the change and the reason for it.

## Verification evidence

List exact commands and their raw pass/fail summaries.
